content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Digital product

A sovereign digital commerce stack is not a workaround; it's the base-layer infrastructure that gives digital creators control over their online store. With NOWPayments, the transaction fees are a mere 0.5%, compared to Gumroad's 10%. But the benefits go beyond cost savings. By owning the stack, creators can design a store that perfectly suits their brand, without being bound by the limitations of a third-party platform. They can collect payments in their preferred cryptocurrency, without worrying about conversion rates or exchange fees.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, a sovereign digital commerce stack consists of five main components: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. Each component plays a vital role in ensuring seamless payment processing, automatic file delivery, and full data ownership. By integrating these components, digital creators can build a store that's both functional and secure.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is built for digital creators in regions where Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad are unavailable or severely restricted. For them, a sovereign digital commerce stack is not just a workaround; it's a necessity. By providing a cost-effective and scalable solution, COREMERCH empowers creators to build a store that's truly their own, without being bound by the limitations of a third-party platform.
A sovereign digital commerce stack is not a workaround; it's the base-layer infrastructure that gives you control over your online store.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Each component in the stack is carefully selected to ensure seamless integration and maximum flexibility. By using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, creators can ensure secure and fast file delivery. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle the backend logic, ensuring automatic payment processing and order storage. Supabase or Google Sheets provide a robust and scalable solution for order storage, while Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 ensure fast and secure file delivery. Finally, NOWPayments verifies payments on-chain, eliminating the need for intermediaries and reducing transaction fees to a mere 0.5%.

By following the simple deployment steps outlined in the kit, creators can have their store up and running in no time.
